items.title: The locus where a module is Cohen-Macaulay is open and its closure is the support
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the set of points where the target module is Cohen-Macaulay is open with closure equal to the support (author lemma at source lines 3874-3883, label lemma-CM-open). The proof (source lines 3885-3904) proves denseness at the generic points of the support, then identifies membership in the locus with the dual having a unique nonzero cohomology module, and uses finiteness of those modules to localise away the unwanted ones, giving an open neighbourhood (proof lines 3885-3903). The localisation step is the substance. H3.
